description: This file defines a React component named ProtectedRoute that acts as a route guard in a React application using react-router. It manages access to protected content based on user authentication status, showing a loading skeleton while authentication state resolves and redirecting to login if unauthenticated.

methods.name: ProtectedRoute({ children })
methods.description: A React functional component that guards protected routes by checking authentication state, displaying a loading indicator or redirecting to login.
